semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in high-end semiconductor wet process equipment, which is critical for both front-end and back-end semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wuxi Haiyi Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, and industrialization of high-performance wet process equipment for the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include single-wafer and tank-type wet cleaning equipment, as well as electroplating equipment, tailored for various semiconductor manufacturing processes.

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Wuxi, China, and is actively involved in local semiconductor industry associations.
